rv_cc01h.by: MA (DCU tab rev 82, MA's Phase 2 slice 1, port NGD budgets)
rv_cc01h.why: An input from ccv_miu_dcu_req (the slot's valid and lead_set_index's bank bits, wired from the channel beside dcu_cap's): DCU's ends at 0 NGD (the tab's row 'every input from ccv_miu_dcu_req', arrival 0). The pick it feeds is flopped here so the RFs' read enable comes from this module's own flops (CG-5).
